displayDescription.en:
BenchCouncil lists Analysis with gpt-3 in the Evaluation Analysis area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “What Makes Good In-Context Examples for GPT-3?”. The page names Jiachang Liu, Weizhu Chen as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
displayDescription.zh:
BenchCouncil 在 AI100（2022-2023）年度表的“评测与分析”领域列出 Analysis with gpt-3。该条目关联论文《What Makes Good In-Context Examples for GPT-3?》。页面把 Jiachang Liu（官方页拼写）、Weizhu Chen（官方页拼写） 列为主要人物。

本 Archive 记录保留官方行序、引用数、机构和国家字段。它表示 2022-2023 年度入选记录，与长期 canonical AI100 故事线分开维护。
